Building Collapses in Delhi Amid Heavy Rain, Multiple Feared Trapped

An under-construction building collapsed in Delhi's Rohini area during heavy rainfall, leading to fears that several people may be trapped under the debris. Rescue operations are underway, with initial reports indicating at least one death. The incident highlights concerns about building safety and the impact of adverse weather conditions.
